headline: Borana Weaves submits AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Routine filing for Borana Weaves holders
summary: Borana Weaves Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. This is a procedural compliance filing required by regulatory norms following shareholder meetings. The submission details the outcome of resolutions presented to investors during the AGM. For an Indian retail investor, this routine governance filing carries no immediate financial impact or stock-moving trigger.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on your portfolio.
